messages:
alana: Quick heads-up — planning a cross-team launch debrief + product summit next Wed 10:00am PT. Will be ~45m: 10m exec context, 15m launch metrics & incidents, 10m customer highlights, 5m two lightning demos, 5m open Q&A. @here please drop any must-cover items in this thread by EOD Friday.

devon: Calendar invite posted: <https://calendar.redwood.com/event/abc123>. Added provisional presenter slots for product, infra, and support.

priya: Can we reserve one of the 5-min demo spots for the retriever caching POC? short demo + 1 slide.

alana: yes — I'll slot the POC for 10:30am PT demo #1 (5m). Priya — add your slide to the shared deck: <https://drive.redwood.com/shared/launch-summit>.

sanjay: Also want to surface the weekend incident FAQ (root-cause + mitigations) during the "launch metrics & incidents" block. Will post a 1-paragraph summary here by EOD.

maria: Quick accessibility ask — please enable live captions + attach an auto transcript. Also if anyone needs ASL interpretation let us know and we'll book.

nathan_ops: @alana allhands-bot will start recording automatically and we can push the transcript to the shared deck afterward. Ops will publish the incident postmortem link in the follow-up doc.

alana: For Qs: drop them here in-thread OR use the short intake form so we can prioritize ahead of time: <https://forms.redwood.com/allhands-qa>. If you want to ask live, mark your question with "LIVE" at the start.

priya: LIVE — will ask about tail-latency changes with the new batching config.

devon: tiny logistics note — please mute mic when not presenting, and if you need demo streaming privileges ping me and I'll grant.

allhands-bot: Reminder scheduled: 24h and 1h before the event. Recording + transcript will be posted to #all-hands-resources after the meeting. :bell:

alana: Action items so far: 1) Priya add slide to shared deck (due Mon EOD). 2) Sanjay post incident summary here (due Fri EOD). 3) Ops/nathan confirm recording & captions (done). 4) Everyone: drop Qs in thread or form. I'll post a final agenda + speaker order by Monday morning. Thanks! :rocket:
